newsitem.title: USA: Sunrise Assisted buys 5 care facilities.
newsitem.headline: Sunrise Assisted buys 5 care facilities.

text.p: Sunrise Assisted Living Inc said on Tuesday it purchased five assisted and independent living facilities in Georgia, Florida and South Carolina for a total of $34 million in cash.
In a separate statement, the company said it entered into a contract to allow it to purchase two more of these communities in southern California for $30.8 million in cash.
This deal would likely close in the first quarter 1997, it said. Sunrise also said it did not assume any debt to buy the five facilities in the southern United States.
Sunrise also said it entered into an affiliation agreement with Jefferson Health Systems to allow the companies to integrate their services.
They would jointly develop a variety of wellness programs for senior citizens in the Philadelphia area.
